caveat: This is a reviewed field-level summary, not a runtime observation. Runtime confidence comes only from the census record. Fields were reconciled with the hook schemas bundled in the pinned executable; contradictions lists every disagreement and how the model resolves it.

events.notes: Starts or resumes a session; source may be startup, resume, clear, compact, or fork. Resume and fork carry four optional prompt-cache staleness fields when the transcript has a response.
One-time initialization hook for --init-only, -p --init, and maintenance mode.
A CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules file entered context.

The submitted prompt as typed, before any skill or command expansion; also fires for turns Claude starts itself, such as a background-agent task notification. prompt_id is the native user-turn correlation when present; the bundled source field is compiled out of the runtime payload.
A user-typed command expanded into its prompt before model processing.
Streaming display delta; display-only and distinct from durable transcript content.
Runs before every tool call, before PermissionRequest when a decision is needed.
Carries no tool_use_id; correlate to the preceding PreToolUse by prompt, tool name, and input.
One completion event per successful tool call.
One failure event per approved tool call that fails.
Runs once after every call in a parallel tool batch resolves.
Auto-mode classifier denial; manual dialog denials do not emit this hook.
Native Claude Code notification; permission_prompt follows a permission dialog after about six idle seconds.
A subagent was spawned.
A subagent finished; stop-hook re-entry must be deduplicated by agent_id. Compaction runs an internal agent that emits SubagentStop with an empty agent_type and no SubagentStart.
TaskCreate is about to create a task.
A task is about to be marked complete.
The assistant finished its turn.
The turn ended because of an API error, or before any request when no credential exists; hook output is observational only. Print mode exits without awaiting its command hooks.
An agent-team teammate is about to become idle.
A settings, policy, or skill configuration source changed.
The active working directory changed.
An additional working directory was registered; the hook runs asynchronously.
A configured matcher watch filename in the current working directory changed on disk; registration without a matcher observes nothing.
Registration replaces Claude Code's default Git worktree creation and must return the created path.
Claude Code is removing a worktree.
Context compaction is about to run and can still be blocked.
Context compaction completed, after the compact SessionStart.

Runs before a requested model switch (/model, a picker, /config, fast mode, SDK set_model) and can cancel it. A hook still running at its timeout (native default 30 s) blocks the switch, so registration is never a passive default.
The session's model changed: a requested switch, an automatic fallback, an opusplan transition, or the model restored on resume. Asynchronous; requested_model is null for auto.
The native session terminated; prompt_id is absent before the first prompt.
An MCP server requested structured user input.
The user response to an MCP elicitation before it is returned to the server.

contradictions.subject: StopFailure.error
contradictions.reference: Lists 12 values: rate_limit, overloaded, authentication_failed, oauth_org_not_allowed, account_on_hold, billing_error, invalid_request, model_not_found, server_error, max_output_tokens, cloud_credential_error, unknown.
contradictions.artifact: The binary enum has 13: the 12 plus verification_required. Census: HTTP 401 -> authentication_failed, 400 -> unknown, 429 -> rate_limit, 500 and 529 -> server_error (529 never produced overloaded).

contradictions.subject: StopFailure command hooks in print mode
contradictions.reference: Silent on delivery timing; says hook output and exit code are ignored.
contradictions.artifact: Since 2.1.283 a print-mode process exits without awaiting StopFailure command hooks: a node forwarder (~100 ms to start) never completes, a shell `cat` hook does, and an HTTP hook arrives. 2.1.226 awaited even a 1 s command hook. A command-hook census therefore misses StopFailure; it still fires on the credential-less and API-error paths.
contradictions.model: StopFailure is runtime-verified through HTTP; the default transport stays http

contradictions.subject: scratchpad_dir
contradictions.reference: Common input field (2.1.257+), absent when the session has no scratchpad.
contradictions.artifact: The runtime input builder adds it only when a scratchpad exists; the bundled SDK base schema omits it; no 2.1.308 census payload carried it.

contradictions.subject: UserPromptSubmit.source
contradictions.artifact: The bundled SDK schema declares an optional enum (user, sdk, system, loop_wakeup, schedule_wakeup, poll_event), but both runtime input builders compile the field out; no payload carried it, including the background-agent task-notification turn.

contradictions.subject: Stop.background_tasks and Stop.session_crons
contradictions.reference: Shown in the Stop input example.
contradictions.artifact: Optional in the bundled schema; absent from every 2.1.308 interactive Stop payload (present on SubagentStop when a background agent runs).

contradictions.subject: SessionEnd.reason
contradictions.reference: Also lists bypass_permissions_disabled, marked removed in 2.1.234.
contradictions.artifact: The binary enum has clear, resume, logout, prompt_input_exit, other.

contradictions.subject: Notification.notification_type
contradictions.reference: Matcher table lists 13 values including plugin_notification.
contradictions.artifact: The bundled schema types it as a plain string; plugin_notification appears in the binary from 2.1.308.

contradictions.subject: PostModelSwitch source resume
contradictions.reference: Fires when Claude Code restores the model on resume.
contradictions.artifact: Not observed: the census resume relaunched by id without --model or ANTHROPIC_MODEL and received no PostModelSwitch.
contradictions.model: enum keeps resume; the branch stays documentation-only

contradictions.subject: effort
contradictions.reference: Present on tool-context events when the model supports the effort parameter.
contradictions.artifact: Absent from every interactive payload under the loopback model id; present on the credential-less headless StopFailure (model alias haiku).

contradictions.subject: FileChanged
contradictions.reference: The matcher names literal files in the working directory.
contradictions.artifact: Observed for a watched file in the session cwd before any cd; the watch list follows cwd.

contradictions.subject: PreModelSwitch timeout
contradictions.reference: Default timeout 30 s; a hook that does not respond before its timeout blocks the switch.
contradictions.artifact: Observed over HTTP; an immediate empty reply preserved native behaviour (the warm-cache confirmation still showed).
contradictions.model: observationMode timeout-blocks, never a default passive registration
